capabilities: Link notes sequentially with Previous/Next frontmatter properties
Render inline prev/next navigation bars and floating side buttons
Show a See Also list of related vault notes and external URLs
Keep reciprocal Prev/Next links in sync across notes automatically
Seed new notes with navigation keys and rename property keys vault-wide
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a developer release section (npm version bumping, GitHub release assets).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define an ordered reading sequence between notes or render prev/next navigation from note metadata.
summary: Sequential note navigation plugin that adds Previous / Next / See Also links from frontmatter properties, rendered inline or as floating buttons.
